verdict.line: On AMD EPYC 9V45 96-Core Processor: Google's 0.30% holds for forward loops with loops aligned (at most 0.7% on k01_sum_fwd, k03_stencil); a loop that loses vectorization under the same check (k04_rev, k05_stride2, k08_matmul) pays 3.98 times (range 2.88 to 5.68; as compiled 4.47), because it loses SIMD. Placement-sensitive, listed and not counted: k02_add_fwd.L1 (as compiled 0.98, aligned 0.83); k02_add_fwd.L2 (as compiled 0.92, aligned 0.90); k03_stencil.L1 (as compiled 1.01, aligned 1.02).
verdict.why: MAP: every counted in-cache cell of k01_sum_fwd, k03_stencil has aligned ratio <= 1.02 and aligned ci95_hi <= 1.0200; every in-cache cell of k04_rev, k05_stride2, k08_matmul has ci95_lo >= 1.5 in both columns; placement-sensitive (layout A/A half-width 0.97%): k02_add_fwd.L1, k02_add_fwd.L2, k03_stencil.L1
